scope: Production numerical repair. Independent high-precision arithmetic checks, native CUDA/FSDP2 integration and paired shared-GPU head microbenchmarks; not a formal training-quality comparison.

real-mdpo.scope:
Four-rank real-teacher mirror diagnostic on four fixed math continuations.

Requires four GPUs and saved fixed-prefix records. Packed SDPA comparisons are
valid here only because each rank/micro-batch contains exactly one sequence.
Use on an allocated GPU pool; the memory cap is not a scheduler reservation.

Uses the production FSDP2 engine, global token normalization, anchor scope and
AdamW. This creates a local low-KL state, not a reconstruction of the original
on-policy E45/E47 history. Pre/post evaluation uses FP64 row arithmetic.

real_logits.scope: 128 saved real prefixes, interpolated native logits; p=q so ideal MDPO and BPO first gradients coincide. FP64 reference retains the target increment separately. Not a late-model replay.

identities.scope: CPU FP64 finite-vocabulary identities; not a language-model training or quality result
identities.J_oracle: 64-point Gauss-Legendre quadrature in log probability ratio
